item_title: Actions Related to the Issuance of Non-Exclusive Franchise Agreements for Residential Clean-out Material

motions.text: a public hearing was conducted and five ordinances were passed for publication
motions.source_text: Upon motion by Councilmember Domingo Candelas, seconded by Councilmember Bien Doan, and carried unanimously

notes: Non-unanimous vote (one councilmember absent) and five named companies that must NOT be extracted as people - they're franchise applicants, i.e. organizations, not individuals. This is a public hearing item, not a plain consent item.
